mentions.name: aep-conformance-test
mentions.description: This tool tests APIs for conformance against the AEP specification (aep.dev). It inventories every MUST, SHOULD, and MAY requirement in the spec and generates conformance tests, producing a report that shows not just whether an API follows the spec but also which parts of the spec it does not implement. It is more thorough than the existing AEP e2e validator.
mentions.problem: An existing AEP e2e validator does something similar but is less thorough and does not generate a report identifying which parts of the spec an API does not implement.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Used Claude to write conformance tests for https://aep.dev.

https://github.com/thegagne/aep-conformance-test

Did pretty well, only took a day or so. I first had it inventory every MUST, SHOULD, and MAY in the spec, and then let it rip.
